entries.source: PHPicker.h of the iOS 16.4 SDK, the SDK this package compiles against, for the declaration and its availability; ALAsset.h and ALAssetsFilter.h of the same SDK for everything the release's library can say about an asset (type, location, duration, orientation, date, representations, URLs, and the three type constants; the filters allPhotos, allVideos and allAssets); and tools/cache-index/first-rung.lua over the 50 held rungs, which answers NONE for _ALAssetTypePanorama and _ALAssetTypePhotoStream
